lesson.menu_desc: A technical change, live, on a call with India: say what is happening right now -- present continuous
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 7 -- The Change Window
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ender de Souza Batista | Lesson 7 -- The Change Window
lesson.grammar_point: present continuous (am / is / are + -ing) for actions happening now, and the difference from the present simple

listenings.text: Hi, everyone, this is Sarah. Quick status update. It is eleven at night here in New York. The change window is open. Right now, the team in Pune is updating the system. The cards are working, but some payments are slow. We are watching them. Ender's team is testing the stores in Brazil. Next update in fifteen minutes.

Here in Mumbai, it is nine thirty in the morning. It is a normal day for us, but it is night in New York. My team is testing the cards of our bank. Two engineers are checking the reports, and one is talking with Raj. Me? Right now, I am drinking my coffee and reading the reports. Everything is working well.

extra_audio.text: The change window is open. Raj is turning off the old service. Ender's team is testing the payments. One store is having a problem. Now Raj is turning on the new update.
